search_algorithm.name: and_or_mcts
search_algorithm.node_selection: MooRetro-style epsilon-greedy UCB1 over explicit MODEL and DATABASE source branches, with candidate-quality and stock priors
search_algorithm.candidate_generation: local MooRetro model and local database queried separately for every expanded OR state; candidates remain under MODEL/DATABASE source nodes during MCTS and complete routes are merged only for Top-K

mcts.expansion: OR route state -> MODEL/DATABASE source nodes -> reaction AND state containing all non-currency precursors
mcts.backpropagation: scalar route-quality reward through source nodes

and_or_tree.and_semantics: solve every non-currency precursor of the selected reaction; no children[0] shortcut is permitted
